title: T10 — Benefits diagram (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Benefits Diagram — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Goals and outcomes

- **Planning that is computed, not asserted.** Cards materialise from the backlog in computed
  WSJF order within the WIP slots, only after the plan is approved, and a repeated tick creates
  nothing (`programme_cadence.rs`, `cadence_jobs.rs::pi_tick_is_idempotent`).
- **Demos that are earned.** A deliverable without typed evidence cannot demo (`demo_gate.rs`).
- **Retros that teach.** A retro cannot close without a lesson (`retro.rs`).
- **Reviews that see the record.** An end-of-tranche review without baselines, benefit status or
  risk evidence is refused (`tranche_review.rs`).
- **Benefits that are measured.** A transition that never measured its baseline cannot report
  the benefit realised (`benefit_transition.rs`).

## Measures

| Measure | Instrument | State |
|---|---|---|
| WSJF materialisation and WIP | `programme_cadence.rs::wsjf_is_computed_not_stored`, `::materialisation_respects_wip_slots` | proved |
| Idempotent PI tick | `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs::pi_tick_is_idempotent` | proved |
| Typed demo evidence | `demo_gate.rs::a_credit_needs_typed_evidence` | proved |
| Retro lesson requirement | `retro.rs::retro_cannot_close_without_lessons` | proved |
| Tranche-review evidence | `tranche_review.rs::a_review_without_evidence_is_refused` | proved |
| Baseline before realisation | `benefit_transition.rs::a_missing_baseline_cannot_claim_realization` | proved |

## Benefits and sub-benefits

The cadence is the delivery machinery the programme's benefits are reviewed against (B4/B5).
Its sub-benefits: predictable PI commitments, an evidence-gated demo, lessons that accumulate,
tranche reviews that cannot pass on prose, and benefit transitions that cannot precede their
baseline. T10 owns no benefit profile itself; the profiles and their measurements are U6's.
